summary: Old Second Bancorp Inc filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share, payable on May 11, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 1, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation decision, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other transformative event disclosed. The filing contains no deal terms or advisor engagement. Investors should view this as a standard dividend declaration with no actionable special-situation implications.
